title: 5can.eth
tagline: We're fixing how indexing is done. Stone-age pessimistic discovery is boring.
description: A single discovery with multicall of token lists on different networks gives a lot of information that wallets and dapps are throwing away each reload and somebody has to store it. We introduce a binary hash tree of user assets that serve as inclussion check data structure to provide better hints about assets that can be loaded for the user and user recognized.
how_its_made: With 5can.eth (aka. scan-evm.eth) and so on maintains a registry of user assets and serves hints using CCIP. We get tokenlists, making not-so optimized requests about balances for lost of assets at the same time based on the assets that other users also recognized as quality ones. App works in two modes: the indexed one on the user behalf (skas.5can.eth) would already return the list of assets that I committed to. And self-hosted when in browser a bunch of requests using deployless lens would be made to get a list of assets with oracle prices (if possible).
